description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps from a private beach access- Located in the heart of Rosemary Beach- Access to 4 neighborhood pools- Access to fitness center and racquet club- Professionally decorated- 2 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: The carriage house at Mozell Cottage is the perfect option for guests looking for a quiet getaway. The beautifully designed condo can sleep 4 guests comfortably. Beautifully decorated with modern and sophisticated artwork, this carriage house has a living room with a full sized sleeper sofa, a flat-screen TV, a private balcony overlooking the courtyard, a dining table, and a kitchen with full-size, stainless steel appliances. There is also a bedroom with a king bed, additional flat-screen TV, and an en-suite bathroom with a walk-in shower. Sip coffee on the porch in the morning before taking a peaceful stroll to the beach or the Rosemary farmer's market held every Sunday morning. Guests renting the carriage house will have access to 4 neighborhood pools, fitness center, racquet club, and 2 adult bikes. Don't miss your chance to vacation at this fabulous home and book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSCARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyLiving area: Full Sleeper Sofa*Your rental property may share a courtyard or lot with a carriage house or main house that is owner-occupied or rented to separate guests from your party. Unfortunately, the private pool is for the main house only.Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
